page.overview:
What is Gewehr Base?

Gewehr is a military base in East Nesher District in Final Fantasy Type-0 and can only be accessed during the Expert Trial "Colonel Faith's Last Stand". In addition, it is Colonel Faith's home town.

Gewehr Base is being inflitrated during the Expert Trial "Colonel Faith's Last Stand" and can only be accessed during this mission.
